## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4 (partial — behavioral test): The silent removal of DSO_LLM_MODEL is verified by a test — setting DSO_LLM_MODEL=some-bogus-id in the runner environment must not change the model used (config-driven model wins)

## Implementation Notes

Add test function `test_dso_llm_model_env_is_ignored` to `tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh` (append before the Summary section).

Test structure (follow same mock pattern as test_runner_integration_llm_api_call_mocked at line 2519):

```bash
# ── test_dso_llm_model_env_is_ignored ──────────────────────────────────────
# Behavioral: DSO_LLM_MODEL env var must be silently ignored — the runner
# uses config-driven model IDs from dso-config.conf via llm-api-call.sh.
# Given: DSO_LLM_MODEL=bogus-model-xyz set in environment, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set,
#        llm-api-call.sh mocked at PATH level
# When:  runner invoked with a fixture diff
# Then:  runner exits 0 and produces reviewer-findings.json (DSO_LLM_MODEL has no effect)
_snapshot_fail
_dso_llm_mock_dir=$(mktemp -d)
_dso_llm_artifacts=$(mktemp -d)
_TEST_TMPDIRS+=("$_dso_llm_mock_dir" "$_dso_llm_artifacts")
_create_mock_llm_api_call "$_dso_llm_mock_dir" "" ""
# (also mock complexity classifier, write-reviewer-findings.sh, record-review.sh)
...
_dso_llm_exit=0
(
    export PATH="$_dso_llm_mock_dir:$PATH"
    export WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR="$_dso_llm_artifacts"
    export DSO_LLM_MODEL='bogus-model-xyz'
    printf 'diff --git a/foo.sh b/foo.sh\n+echo hello\n' | ANTHROPIC_API_KEY='x' bash "$RUNNER"
) || _dso_llm_exit=$?
assert_eq "test_dso_llm_model_env_is_ignored: runner exits 0 when DSO_LLM_MODEL is set" "0" "$_dso_llm_exit"
# verify findings written (runner completed despite DSO_LLM_MODEL)
assert_eq "test_dso_llm_model_env_is_ignored: reviewer-findings.json written" "true" \
    "$([[ -f "$_dso_llm_artifacts/reviewer-findings.json" ]] && echo true || echo false)"
assert_pass_if_clean "test_dso_llm_model_env_is_ignored"
```

DSO_LLM_MODEL is not referenced anywhere in ci-llm-review-runner.sh (verified: grep returns nothing). This test confirms the env var has zero effect on runner behavior.

## TDD Requirement

testing_mode: GREEN — unit exemption criterion 1: DSO_LLM_MODEL is already fully absent from the runner (grep confirms no reference). The test verifies pre-existing correct behavior (the env var being silently ignored). A RED test would be impossible since no new source code change is being made. Test passes immediately.
